'''Lagon''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter and part of a group of Trandoshans that hunted down innocent beings for sport on [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. He accompanied the group's leader, [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac]], on his hover platform. He hunted [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], whom Garnac wanted revenge on. He chased after Tano for a while, but eventually lost her scent and abandoned his hunt, heading back to the Trandoshans' [[Ubrikkian floating fortress]] along with his leader. He was later killed in the attack on the Trandoshan fortress where [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] threw him over the rail of the [[Ubrikkian floating fortress|Trandoshan floating fortress]] where upon he plummeted to his [[Death/Legends|death]] after he failed to realize that Wookiees were attacking them.
